T 4 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java

T 99 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java
L    * example a nesting limit of 0 means no arrays or objects may be opened at all, a nesting limit
T 98 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java

T 100 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java
L    * allows reading the JSON data <code>[{"a":[true]}]</code>, but for a nesting limit of 2 it would
T 100 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java
L    * fail at the inner {@code [true]}.

T 4 source.java meta.class.java meta.class.body.java comment.block.javadoc.java
